# lifecycle

The session state machine, liveness, reconcile on start, shutdown policy, resume to idle.

- Spec: `docs/features/lifecycle/spec.md`
- Contract: `docs/features/lifecycle/contract.md`

## Files

```
go: internal/session/**
go: internal/server/sessionwire*.go
go: internal/store/session*.go
go: internal/store/store*.go
go: internal/store/migrate*.go
go: internal/store/migrations/**
web: web/src/sessions/store*.ts
web: web/src/sessions/live*.ts
e2e: web/e2e/reconcile.spec.ts
e2e: web/e2e/helpers/session.ts
```

## Protocol

- `state` — The state machine
- `state.displayed` — Displayed states
- `state.tracked` — Per-session tracked variables
- `state.transitions` — Transitions
- `state.ordering` — Ordering & loss tolerance
- `state.liveness` — Liveness
- `ws.session` — The Session object
- `ws.session-upsert` — `sessionUpsert`
